reason: With the edition beside the images the cut line fragments could be placed in a known text, correcting misread groups (hiran ons to [noch]tan ons, erbaer ons to en laet ons, chort to choer) and showing that the scrap supplies the other ends of the strips' lines.
sources: N. van Wijk, Het getijdenboek van Geert Grote naar het Haagse handschrift 133 E 21, Leiden 1940, p. 111 (DBNL transcription, grot001geti01_01_0011)
Corpus Middelnederlands (Dutch Language Institute), text 'Getijdenboek van Geert Grote', searched for the hymn and antiphon
text:
Source-assisted reading of F-3l5z (Antwerpen, Ruusbroecgenootschap, Neerl. 413/45), made with the text of Van Wijk 1940, p. 111 (DBNL transcription) beside the images. Reread on the image: strips verso lines 2-10 and recto lines 1-6; scrap lines 1-5 of both faces. Strips recto lines 7-10 and scrap line 6 rest on the image-only first reading. [ ] = lost, supplied from the edition; (?) = uncertain; ... = lost middle of the line.

RECTO. Strips: canvas 0 (fol. [1]r), native box 290,90,650,620 (line ends). Scrap: canvas 4 (fol. [3]r), native box 220,130,390,430 (line beginnings).
scrap 1            choer [des hemels ende weder haelt]
scrap 2            dine lo[ue ihesus uerblijt den om]
scrap 3 / strips 1 ganc d[er werlt] ... [..]m(?)[..] ons(?) te v(?)   (strips rubbed, uncertain)
scrap 4 / strips 2 reden mit [gode] ... [ihes]us is weter ghe
scrap 5 / strips 3 gaen t(?)[o den vader] ... hi is in ghegaen
strips 4           [in dat h]emelsche(?) r[ike]   (rubbed)
strips 5           [..] ende(?) is ihesus(?)       (rubbed)
strips 6           [o ewighe wijs]heit
strips 7           [..]ghe(n)(?)   (first reading)
strips 8-10        line ends only: ..im(?), ..ghe(?), ..oun(?)   (first reading)

VERSO. Strips: canvas 1 (fol. [1]v), native box 190,200,580,720 (line beginnings). Scrap: canvas 5 (fol. [3]v), native box 215,100,375,400 (line ends).
scrap 1            [..]eiden(?)
strips 1 / scrap 2 m[..] m[..] ... uan(?) si[..]   (not placed in the text)
scrap 3            ... O glor   (O touched red)
strips 2 / scrap 4 ose coninc on[der dinen] ... [h]eilighe[n]
strips 3 / scrap 5 du bis altoes l[ouelic] ... [e]nde(?) [noch]
strips 4           [..]tan ons[prekelic]
strips 5           [..]ns(?) ende dine
strips 6           an gherope[n]
strips 7           en laet ons n[iet]
strips 8           en(?) [.]nden dagh(?)[..]   (rubbed; e n, slit, one or two minims, d/u, e, n, then d/t, a, g, h with a stroke; compatible with "in den daghe")
strips 9           waerdighe[..]
strips 10          onder dinen h[eilighen]

Not read: canvases 2 and 3 (fol. [2]r/v), a narrow strip with ink traces only.
